name: Milton Industries Ltd
description:
AboutIncorporated in 1985, Milton Industries Ltd primarily operates in laminate segments.[1]Key PointsBusiness Overview:[1]MIL is an ISO 9001:2008 certified co. engaged in manufacturing of Laminates,Artificial Leather Cloth and Glass Fibre Reinforced Epoxy (GFRE) Sheets.  Initially,the company was engaged in manufacturing of laminates and further diversified into the manufacturing and export of Artificial Leather cloth, GFRE Sheets, DGFRP, CCL and NAFTC.The products of the company are primarily used in real estate and artificial leather and polymers in Indian railways and roadways. In addition, the company also has a High-Pressure Hydraulic Press in which it manufactures 12 x 6 size of compact laminate which is mostly in demand in Europe, America, and Australia.Read MoreWebsiteNSE
